mapper.insert: INSERT INTO external_data.received_record (id, external_record_id, ingestion_id, payload_hash, payload_object_key, acquired_at, classification, classification_note, classified_at, first_line_number, last_line_number) VALUES (#{id}, #{externalRecordId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{ingestionId}, #{payloadHash}, #{payloadObjectKey}, #{acquiredAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{classification}, #{classificationNote,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{classifiedAt}, #{firstLineNumber,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{lastLineNumber,jdbcType=INTEGER})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM external_data.received_record WHERE ingestion_id = #{ingestionId} AND classification = #{classification}

SELECT id, external_record_id, ingestion_id, payload_hash, payload_object_key, acquired_at, classification, classification_note, classified_at, first_line_number, last_line_number FROM external_data.received_record WHERE ingestion_id = #{ingestionId} AND classification = 'QUARANTINED' ORDER BY first_line_number NULLS FIRST, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql:
FROM external_data.received_record r JOIN external_data.ingestion i ON i.id = r.ingestion_id LEFT JOIN external_data.external_record e ON e.id = r.external_record_id WHERE r.classification = 'QUARANTINED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM external_data.received_record_decision d WHERE d.received_record_id = r.id)
AND r.ingestion_id = #{ingestionId}
mapper.select:
SELECT r.id, r.ingestion_id, i.ingested_at, i.data_source_id, r.first_line_number, r.last_line_number, e.external_id, e.external_version, r.classification_note
ORDER BY i.ingested_at DESC, r.ingestion_id, r.first_line_number NULLS FIRST, r.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, external_record_id, ingestion_id, payload_hash, payload_object_key, acquired_at, classification, classification_note, classified_at, first_line_number, last_line_number FROM external_data.received_record WHERE id = #{id} AND ingestion_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT r.id, r.external_record_id, r.ingestion_id, r.payload_hash, r.payload_object_key, r.acquired_at, r.classification, r.classification_note, r.classified_at, r.first_line_number, r.last_line_number
AND r.external_record_id IS NULL ORDER BY r.first_line_number NULLS FIRST, r.id

SELECT COUNT(*)
AND r.external_record_id IS NULL
